WITH department_counts AS (
  SELECT major.department, COUNT(DISTINCT income.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM income
  JOIN member ON CAST(member.member_id AS TEXT) = CAST(income.link_to_member AS TEXT)
  JOIN major ON CAST(major.major_id AS TEXT) = CAST(member.link_to_major AS TEXT)
  GROUP BY major.department
),
department_shares AS (
  SELECT department, member_count,
         CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM department_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM department_shares
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT department, member_count, share, share - average_share AS excess
  FROM department_shares CROSS JOIN average_share
  WHERE share > average_share
)
SELECT SUM(member_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess)
FROM qualifying
